about_the_game:
🦫 BEAVER RAMPAGE

Step into the paws of a murderous beaver and unleash chaos wherever you go!
BEAVER RAMPAGE is a wacky experience full of explosions, wood, and... hats.

🔥 What do you do?

  • Bite people (literally).

  • Munch down trees like a pro.

  • Build wooden bridges with the logs you collect.

  • Destroy wooden buildings like there's no tomorrow.

  • Shoot weapons and cause mayhem.

  • Get caught in traps.

  • Experiment, have fun, and wreck everything.

All of it wrapped up in a charming, low-poly world of pure destruction.

🎩 Game Features:

  • Funny game with levels — each level is a new playground of chaos.

  • Constant updates — new levels will be added frequently!

  • Beaver customization — unlock and change hats to match your style.

  • Low system requirements — runs smoothly even on older machines.

  • Growing gameplay time — more content with every update.

If you've ever dreamed of being an angry beaver with a passion for wood and destruction — this is your moment.

BEAVER RAMPAGE – never underestimate a beaver with a gun.

content_descriptors.notes: You play as an angry beaver who solves problems the only way he knows how — by biting off limbs. Humans explode into low-poly chunks, heads roll (literally), and sometimes our furry friend gets pancaked by a car or blown up by a bomb. It’s all cartoon chaos with zero realism and maximum ridiculousness.
